headline: SIGN AFTER CHANGES: 3 entity/term blockers and 1 dependency on unsigned master agreement
nextAction: Jay must update the contracting entity and liability terms while Karandeep secures the Lakeshore MSA.

findings.title: Wrong AtliQ entity: Pvt Ltd instead of Inc
findings.impact: Names AtliQ Pvt Ltd, but the end client is in USA: AtliQ Inc is the entity for US work, so this should be AtliQ Inc. The entity decides who invoices, the tax regime and the bank account; a mismatch caused two payment delays in 2025.

citations.quote: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd**, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013

findings.standard: AtliQ Inc contracts with US clients only; AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd with everyone else.
findings.counterPosition: Name AtliQ Inc in the parties clause, invoicing clause and signature block and use the US template (US law, USD).

findings.title: Non-solicitation of clients
findings.impact: This is a 'client-capture' provision that AtliQ's playbook explicitly flags as a term to never accept from a client.

citations.quote: During the term of this Agreement, the Contractor shall devote his professional working time exclusively to the Company and shall not, directly or indirectly, provide services to, or be engaged or employed by, any other person, firm or company, whether paid or unpaid, without the Company's prior written consent

For a period of twelve (12) months after termination or expiry of this Agreement, the Contractor shall not, anywhere in the world, directly or indirectly, provide any software or data services to any person, whether as an employee, consultant, contractor, partner or otherwise, in competition with the Company
For a period of twelve (12) months after termination or expiry, the Contractor shall not solicit or accept work from any client of the Company for whom he performed Services

findings.standard: None, or narrow geography + short duration, always checked against the register; mutual exit where possible. No non-competes on freelancers/vendors beyond non-solicit of client staff.
findings.counterPosition: Limit non-solicitation to AtliQ's employees only.

citations.quote:
The Company may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving twenty-four (24) hours' written notice (including by email) to the Contractor.
9.2 The Contractor may terminate this Agreement by giving sixty (60) days' written notice to the Company
On termination, the Company shall pay for approved hours up to the termination date in accordance with Clause 4

findings.standard: On any termination for convenience AtliQ is paid for all work done, including work in progress. Notice is mutual. Client contracts: reasonable notice (typically 30+ days). Freelancer / vendor agreements: a mutual short exit (about 15 days, as with Rohan Iyer) is AtliQ's standard and fair to both sides.
findings.counterPosition: Make the notice period mutual (e.g., 15 days).

findings.standard: Indian law for Pvt Ltd; US law for Inc.
findings.counterPosition: Law of the relevant US state; US forum.

citations.quote: Vendor shall notify Lakeshore within seventy-two (72) hours of discovering any unauthorized access to Lakeshore Data

findings.standard: DPA (EU) or BAA (US health) signed before any personal/regulated data moves, with a sub-DPA / sub-BAA for every party that touches the data (incl. AtliQ's own Pune entity); engagement-specific scope; offshore access only as the agreement allows.
findings.counterPosition: Add a specific requirement for the contractor to notify AtliQ of any data incident within 24-48 hours.

findings.title: One-way uncapped indemnity
findings.impact: The contractor is required to indemnify AtliQ for direct losses without any reciprocal protection for the contractor's own risks.

citations.quote: The Contractor shall indemnify the Company against losses arising from the Contractor's breach of Clauses 6 or 7 or his wilful misconduct

findings.standard: Mutual: each party covers its own breach and negligence; never the other side's negligence. IP-infringement indemnity for deliverables is normal.
findings.counterPosition: Provide mutual indemnities for third-party claims arising from a party's negligence or conflict, subject to the liability cap.

findings.title: One-sided liability cap
findings.impact: The contractor remains exposed to unlimited liability while AtliQ's liability is strictly limited.

citations.quote: The Company's liability to the Contractor shall not exceed the fees payable for the preceding three (3) months

findings.standard: Each party's aggregate liability capped at 1× fees (paid or payable in the prior 12 months), mutual; carve-outs only for fraud, wilful misconduct and confidentiality (plus any carve-outs that are mandatory under the governing law, e.g. German law for intent/gross negligence and injury).
findings.counterPosition: Make the cap mutual and set it at 1x fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim.

citations.quote: The Contractor is responsible for his own taxes, insurance and statutory compliance

citations.docTitle: Lakeshore Grocers MSA + SOW-1 + rate card (draft)
citations.quote: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability ($1,000,000) and professional liability ($2,000,000) insurance

findings.standard: Apply the same standard AtliQ asks for as a supplier: capped penalties or none, 30-day pay, mutual caps, no pay-when-paid, fair termination. Pass the client's obligations down (IP, confidentiality, data protection, consent), never the client's leverage.
findings.counterPosition: Require the contractor to maintain professional liability and general liability insurance at levels sufficient to cover their potential indemnity obligations.

fine: Parties = invoicing entity: Pvt Ltd throughout

The 5-year confidentiality survival period and standard exclusions are acceptable for a freelancer agreement.
No liquidated damages are imposed on the contractor, which is favorable for AtliQ's paper.
notSeen: No meeting notes attached to this deal.

12.1 In consideration of the Client disclosing to the Supplier its Confidential Information, including its revenue strategies, pricing models and Guest Data, the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
